identity.checkpoint_recovery: exact saved optimizer/RNG; replay unsaved updates after a hard interruption

data_parallel.draw_assignment: global draw index = step*global_microbatches + rank + local_micro*world_size
data_parallel.evaluation: native batch-one inference; disjoint complete condition groups by rank
data_parallel.gradient_reduction: SUM(loss/global_microbatches gradients), then global clip and AdamW
data_parallel.serial_numerical_equivalence: same objective and draws; reduction order can change FP32 rounding

initial_writer.baseline: measured from the initialized parameters before any new optimizer update
initial_writer.optimizer_and_rng: new experiment: fresh AdamW and configured seed; no parent optimizer or RNG restored

endpoint_recount.scope: 17 seen semantic questions; development is not independent prefix/chain validation.
